remarks: Welcome to this charming 4-bedroom, 1.5-bath two-story home nestled on a quiet neighborhood street in the Village of Medina! Just a short walk to Main Street, enjoy the convenience of being close to local shops, restaurants, businesses, parks, and the school. An inviting covered front porch welcomes you into the foyer and sets the tone for the warm and comfortable living spaces inside. The bright and spacious living room flows into a formal dining room, creating an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining. The eat-in galley kitchen offers plenty of functionality, while a convenient first-floor bedroom and half bath provide flexible living options for guests, a home office, or one-level living. Upstairs, you'll find three generously sized bedrooms and a full bath, providing plenty of space for everyone. A large Florida sunroom off the back of the home offers an additional space to relax, entertain, or enjoy the changing seasons. Have peace of mind with the whole house generator! Outside, a detached 1.5-car garage provides added storage and parking. With its desirable village location, spacious layout, and easy access to everything Medina has to offer, this home is ready to welcome its next owner!
